messages:
maria: Thanks everyone for staying after the all-hands. Putting a short Q&A thread here for infra/regions/provisioning priorities.
jon: Quick one — are we still prioritizing H100s for EMEA, or switching to A100 due to supply?
ken: Short answer: rolling mix. H100s are preferred for latency-heavy models but supply is intermittent. We plan a 60/40 H100/A100 mix in EMEA for Q2, adjustable by workload.
alex: For Dedicated customers, will we allow region pinning by SKU?
ken: Yes, region pinning will be supported on Dedicated; UI + API flag planned. Docs will show SKU availability per region.
priya: Can you summarize how autoscaler fallback will work when SKU is out? I had a few product questions.
jon: Fallback policy: try same region different SKU, then cross-region fallthrough within allowed latency SLAs, then burst to cloud partners. Config: policy priority list + max added latency.
alex: Is there a recommended config for latency-sensitive routes?
jon: Recommend: prefer H100, allow A100 fallback, cross-region only if added p95 < 150ms. We'll add a default policy in the console.
maria: Ops note: we're also testing warm pools to reduce cold-starts for model load. Expect ~30-50% lower tail latencies in trials.
infra-bot: [deploy] warm-pool-service v0.2 deployed to staging at commit abc123.
priya: Any timeline on when the regional SKU dashboard will be live?
ken: ETA: end of next sprint (2 weeks). It will include realtime supply signals and expected procurement delays.
alex: For Private customers, will procurement be visible or just recommended?
ken: Private: we will provide recommended SKUs + procurement lead time; actual procurement remains customer-managed in on-prem cases.
maria: Action items: ken to post SKU availability matrix, jon to draft default fallback policy, priya to update product roadmap. We'll sync next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
jon: Also logging note — please file any examples of latency regressions against fallback so we can tune thresholds.
priya: Will do. Thanks!
ken: Thanks all.
